MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The twelve-pack of super glue felt like a plausible next choice because it could help with small household repairs alongside my screws and anchors, though it was only a moderate match.",
    "Repair supplies fit part of my recent activity, especially the purchases of wood screws and drywall anchors."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Relays, heat shrink tubing, wiring connectors, and test leads assume an electrical project that my recent purchases do not establish.",
    "The cutting wheels, pipe coupling, thermometer, and caliper need specific tasks or compatible equipment; their general usefulness does not give me a reason to choose them now.",
    "Twenty-four bottles of Gorilla glue would exceed my occasional repair needs, especially after choosing another glue pack."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "Buying nails, screws, and anchors seems to have been taken as interest in almost any workshop supply.",
    "The suggestions assume that doing household repairs also means doing plumbing, automotive wiring, and precision measurement."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My repeated fastening purchases point more clearly toward securing and assembling things than toward unrelated specialist work.",
    "Exact fit matters: my nail purchases specify angles and dimensions, and my vacuum bags specify compatible types, so a broadly related item is not enough.",
    "Pack size affects whether I would choose something now: even twelve glue tubes is more than I immediately need."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The suggestions partly recognized household repair needs but stretched them into specialized tasks and quantities I do not currently need."
}
